title: Transaction
description: An isolated change set off a base world revision. Non-overlapping component patches merge; overlapping ones are rejected with field-level precision. Replaces asset-path file locking with component-scoped concurrency.

base_revision.description: World revision this change set forked from.

actor.description: Agent or human identity that owns the change set.

work_item.description: Builders Gate queue item this transaction serves.

operations.description: Ordered typed mutations. Each targets an addressable component/field or entity.

from.description: Expected current value (optimistic concurrency; omit for adds).

validation.description: Result of schema + unit + invariant checks, filled by transaction.create/validate.

simulation_evidence.description: Run identifiers + assertions produced while proving this change (see run_identifier + evidence_manifest).

dependencies_changed.description: Components/entities/assets/tests this transaction touches — the merge/conflict surface.

conflict.description: Set when status=conflict. Field-level, not file-level.
